import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from statsmodels.datasets import co2

# Load the 40-element Stata reference data (CO2 dataset)
# This is the standard reference data used in statsmodels tests
data = co2.load_pandas().data
x = data['co2'].values

# Prepend 1 NaN to the 40-element reference data
x = np.concatenate([[np.nan], x[:40]])

try:
    from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import acf, pacf
    from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import acorr_ljungbox
    
    # For test_qstat_drop - compute Ljung-Box test results
    res_drop = acorr_ljungbox(x, lags=10, return_df=True)
    
    # res_drop[2][:40] - get the third column (qstat), first 40 elements
    probe("test_qstat_drop", res_drop.iloc[:40, 2].values)
    
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("test_qstat_drop", e)

try:
    from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import acf
    from statsmodels.graphics.tsaplots import plot_acf
    
    # For test_confint_drop - compute ACF with confidence intervals
    res_drop = acf(x, nlags=10, alpha=0.05)
    
    # res_drop[1] - confidence intervals (second element of acf return)
    probe("test_confint_drop", res_drop[1])
    
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("test_confint_drop", e)
